title: 2027 - Tax Intern, New York City
salary_raw:
We're seeking someone who's curious, detail-oriented, and excited to learn how a modern tax department operates from the inside out. As a MongoDB Tax Intern, you’ll get hands-on experience with US tax return schedules, international tax forms, preparing information for audits, gathering accounting data, updating agreements,  and booking journal entries.  You will also collaborate with the worldwide tax department and along with collaborating with teams like payroll, accounting, stock administration, etc… all while building a strong foundation in corporate tax.

What we are looking for in you

  • In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Have a foundation with tax concepts or tax coursework, strong Excel skills, and a curiosity to explore a career in tax.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively via Slack and other tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. Graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.

What you'll find at MongoDB

  • Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work, we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation.
  • Personalized Mentorship: Pair up with a Mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to foster your growth.
  • Career Coaching Sessions: Access to a tailored training program designed uniquely for interns’ personal and professional development.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Embrace "Bloom for Interns" with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more!
  • Impactful Projects: Contribute to projects where you can Make it Matter - your meaningful work will see the light of day.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Ship a feature to production and design product concepts that balance complexity with simplicity, flexibility, and practicality.

 - Help craft details of new product features, from initial ideas to visual design.

 - Shadow designers, product managers, and engineers to learn about the product development process.

 - Participate in meetings with our Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams to understand user needs and preferences.

 - Collaborate with the Marketing team to brainstorm ideas for storytelling across various platforms.

 - Learn about and contribute to our design system, focusing on creating intuitive and practical patterns.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before Summer 2028.

 - This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our NY office during this time.

 - Previous internship experience.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

 - Fluent in Figma; comfortable working with coding agents (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code).




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - You're enthusiastic about product design and eager to learn. No specific years of experience required.

 - You have a good eye for aesthetics and can create visually appealing interfaces.

 - You can decompose and synthesize complex problems into intuitive ideas or concepts.

 - You're interested in understanding how design decisions impact business needs and user satisfaction.

 - You're open-minded and receptive to feedback. You work well in collaborative environments and are eager to learn from others.

 - You enjoy communicating ideas through both visual and written means.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're eager to learn about designing and building tools in a collaborative environment.

 - You bring a fresh perspective and are excited to contribute your unique ideas to the team.

 - You have a basic understanding of HTML and CSS, and are interested in learning more about how design and code intersect. (Knowledge of JavaScript or AI is a bonus, but not required!)

 - You're curious about how different tools work together and are interested in exploring ways to improve user experiences.

 - You're enthusiastic about technology and design, and are keen to learn about influential figures in computing history.
